lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno hopped and wiggled round,
Are there ants? He jumped and bounced!
Kiki laughed, no ants, it's true,
You just can't sit still, that's you!
[chorus]
Ants in your pants, ants in your pants,
Wiggle, jiggle, hop and dance!
Ants in your pants, ants in your pants,
Can't sit still, not a chance!
[verse]
It means you're restless, full of zip,
You bounce and fidget, hop and skip,
You just can't wait, you can't sit still,
So take a breath and chill, chill, chill!
[chorus]
Ants in your pants, ants in your pants,
Wiggle, jiggle, hop and dance!
Ants in your pants, ants in your pants,
Shake it out and take a stance!
[outro]
So when you wiggle, jump and prance,
You've got some ants inside your pants!
